entries.note: Only the GL/main thread calls frame/next. Separate workers handle frame writes and input reads; one pending frame replaces older work, and the input queue resets held controls on overflow/disconnect. Pixel readback is synchronous and the hot path still allocates and takes a brief mutex; resource budgets and lower-cost GPU transfer remain unqualified. The GL hook preserves default read-buffer selection, read FBO and pixel-pack state. Logical/physical DPI behavior requires separate qualification.
